missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Союз' is the masculine nominative subject of the sentence. 'Крепкий' is the agreeing masculine adjective and 'очень' intensifies the description.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Союз' is the accusative direct object of 'создали'. For inanimate masculine nouns the accusative looks like the nominative. 'Новый' agrees and 'две страны' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Союза' is the genitive form required by 'из', expressing movement out of something. 'Военного' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Союзу' is the dative form required by 'к', expressing joining toward something. 'Страна' is the nominative subject of 'присоединилась'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Союзом' is instrumental because 'гордиться' governs the instrumental case. 'Нашим' agrees in the masculine instrumental, and 'мы' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В союзе' uses the prepositional form 'союзе' after 'в' to locate membership. 'Этом' agrees and 'много стран' states the quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Союз' is the masculine nominative subject of 'защищает'. 'Интересы' is the accusative plural object and 'народа' is genitive showing whose interests.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Союзы' is the nominative plural subject of 'существуют', which agrees in the plural. 'Разные' agrees in the plural and 'в мире' locates them.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О союзе' uses the prepositional form 'союзе' after 'о' to express the topic of the treaty. 'Президент' is the subject and 'договор' the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Союз' is the masculine nominative subject of 'распался', which agrees in masculine gender. 'Их' marks possession and 'очень быстро' adds manner.
